capabilities: Uncheck all checked checklist items in the open document
Check all unchecked checklist items in the open document
Uncheck selected checklist items in editor mode
Strip matching text from checklist lines when resetting
extras: Works only in editor mode for the reset-selection command; README notes current support limited to Markdown and Canvas files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to bulk-check or uncheck task checkboxes in a document, so users must edit each item by hand.
summary: Adds commands to reset (uncheck) or check all checklist items in the open Markdown or Canvas document.
